categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in high-end special steel materials and high-end equipment components manufacturing. Key product lines include gear steel, mold steel, high-temperature alloys, special stainless steel, wind power castings, wind power main shafts, precision mechanical parts for wind power gearboxes, cast steel parts, and other precision components. These products serve industries such as new energy wind power, energy equipment, rail transportation, mechanical equipment, military, aerospace, nuclear power, and marine petrochemical sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced metallurgical technologies including vacuum melting, electric arc furnace refining, electroslag remelting, forging, casting, heat treatment, and precision machining. It has developed proprietary production processes for high-purity and high-performance special alloys, wind power components, and precision gear steel. The firm emphasizes full-process control from smelting, forming, heat treatment to precision finishing, and has integrated 3D printing technology for complex castings. It holds numerous patents and core technologies in alloy smelting, casting, forging, and heat treatment.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's main customers are leading equipment manufacturers in new energy wind power, energy equipment, rail transportation, mechanical equipment, military, aerospace, nuclear power, and marine petrochemical industries. It has strategic partnerships with major domestic and international clients such as Siemens, ZF, CRRC, and others. The new energy wind power sector accounts for over 58% of its revenue, reflecting a strong focus on wind turbine components and related equipment.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with four major production bases located in Zhangjiagang (Jiangsu), Rugao (Jiangsu), and Deyang (Sichuan). It also has established overseas marketing and technical cooperation, particularly in Europe, including Germany. Domestic sales dominate, accounting for over 96% of revenue, with exports mainly to Europe and other regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across the upstream to downstream spectrum of the special steel and high-end equipment component supply chain. It controls core processes including smelting, forming, heat treatment, and precision machining, enabling full-process manufacturing capabilities. The firm is extending its industrial chain downstream by developing precision mechanical parts and cast steel components, enhancing integration and value addition.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on innovation in high-end special alloys, wind power components, and precision mechanical parts. It invests heavily in R&D, with a 4.94% revenue ratio in 2023, developing new materials like high-purity steels, low-cost ultra-high-strength steels, and advanced casting and forging technologies. Key R&D projects include large-scale wind power castings, high-end precision parts, and special alloy materials for military and nuclear applications. The company also emphasizes intellectual property protection and technology upgrades to support import substitution and market expansion.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of high-end special steel materials and precision equipment components to end customers, including OEMs in wind power, energy, and transportation sectors. The company follows an order-driven production model ('make-to-order'), ensuring customized product delivery. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales channels domestically and internationally, with no distribution intermediaries.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In the special steel segment, the company competes with large state-owned groups like CITIC Special Steel, Dongbei Special Steel, and Baosteel Special Steel, as well as specialized private enterprises. It holds a niche position focusing on high-technical-demand, small-volume wind power materials. In wind power castings, it is among the leading domestic manufacturers with advantages in large-scale production and technology, competing with state-owned heavy industry firms and private companies like Riyue and Jixin Technology. The company is positioned as a technologically advanced, integrated supplier with growing market share in high-end segments.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 3.79 billion, a 12.51% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 109.2 million, up 6.10%. Total assets reached RMB 10.66 billion, with net assets of RMB 3.53 billion. The company has shown steady growth in revenue and profitability, supported by capacity expansion projects and increased sales in wind power components. R&D investment increased by 4.46% to RMB 187 million, reflecting ongoing innovation efforts.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive industrial chain capabilities, enabling full-process control from raw material smelting to precision machining, ensuring high product quality, stability, and customization. It differentiates through advanced metallurgical technologies, proprietary core technologies, and strong R&D capabilities, enabling the production of high-purity, high-performance special alloys and precision components tailored for demanding applications in wind power, aerospace, and military sectors. Its focus on import substitution, technological innovation, and strategic partnerships enhances its competitive edge and customer value.
